notes: This contract pins the embedded Connection Lost scenario to the exact IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ FederateAmbassador callback. The callback is invoked on a best-effort basis after the private transport endpoint forces the member out of the execution; the second case also validates a configured DELETE_OBJECTS automatic-resign disposition before that callback. It is source/API traceability only; protected review, package support, remote transport, and conformance remain open.
